content.title: Chapter 98 - TAXATION — Sec. 98-34. - Inspection of records.
content.summary:
The city, its officers, agents or representatives shall have the right at all reasonable
               hours and times to examine the books and records of the providers which are subject
               to the provisions of this article and to make copies of the entries or contents thereof.
        …

faqs.a:
The city, its officers, agents or representatives shall have the right at all reasonable
               hours and times to examine the books and records of the providers which are subject
               to the provisions of this article and to make copies of the entries or contents thereof.
               Except under court order, or in connection with enforcing this chapter, the city shall
               not divulge these books, records, or copies to any other person.
(Code 1981, § 31-19; Ord. No. 3783, § 2, 12-16-2002)
